The unmodified Mediabunny core is provided under the Mozilla Public License 2.0.
The full license is in LICENSE. No optional codec-extension packages or FFmpeg
binaries are included in this distribution. Remuxing does not add codecs that
the browser cannot decode and does not bypass provider CORS, HTTPS or DRM.

## Corresponding covered source

The original npm archive, mediabunny-1.65.2.tgz, is served beside this notice and the
JavaScript bundle. It includes package/src/*.ts: the preferred source form of
the covered library, including its MPL notices, along with package metadata,
README and the original distribution. No library files have been modified.
Our separate adapter is web/remux_bridge.js in the IPTV Pro source repository.
The MPL-covered library source remains available under MPL-2.0; application
terms do not restrict rights granted by that license.
